subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: A Magic Bean plot is in Kokiri Forest right beside the shop.

evidence.quote: This one is in Kokiri Forest right beside the shop.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: As soon as you enter Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest, head left until you reach a Magic Bean plot.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest, head left until
 you reach this one.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: When entering Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest, head right, left, right, left, then left to find a hole behind a Business Scrub.

evidence.quote:
When you enter Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest, head right, left,
 right, left, then left. This hole is here behind a Business Scrub.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: A Magic Bean hole is located right by the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern in Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote:
Right by the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern in Death Mountain Trail is
 this hole.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: In Kakariko Graveyard, a Magic Bean hole is up on the upper ground.

evidence.quote: In Kakariko Graveyard, this hole is up on the upper ground.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: A Magic Bean plot is located right beside the Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: This one is right beside the Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: In Gerudo Valley, grab a Cucco and fly down to the very bottom of the cliff over to the left to find a plot.

evidence.quote:
In Gerudo Valley, grab a Cucco and fly down to the very bottom of the
 cliff over to the left to find this plot.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: Once Bolero of Fire is learned, warp Young Link to the Fire Temple with it to find a plot of dirt.

evidence.quote:
Once you have learned Bolero of Fire, warp Young Link to the Fire
 Temple with it and you'll find this plot of dirt.

subject: Magic Bean Plot
text: Once Desert Colossus is reached as Adult Link and Requiem of Spirit is learned, warp Young Link there to find a plot of dirt.

evidence.quote:
Once you have reached the Desert Colossus as Adult Link and learned
 the Requiem of Spirit, warp Young Link over here and you'll find this last 
 plot of dirt.

subject: Adult's Wallet
text: Collecting 10 Skulltulas gives the Adult's Wallet, which lets Link carry 200 Rupees as opposed to the previous 99.

evidence.quote:
10 Skulltulas: Gives you the Adult's Wallet, which lets you carry 200 Rupees,
 as opposed to the previous 99 that you could carry.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Collecting 20 Skulltulas gives the Stone of Agony, which rumbles with the Rumble Pak whenever something secret is nearby.

evidence.quote:
20 Skulltulas: Gives you the Stone of Agony. If you have the Rumble Pak, it
 will rumble whenever there is something secret nearby.

subject: Giant's Wallet
text: Collecting 30 Skulltulas gives the Giant's Wallet, which lets Link carry 500 Rupees as the final Rupee upgrade.

evidence.quote:
30 Skulltulas: Gives you the Giant's Wallet, which lets you carry 500 Rupees.
 This is the final Rupee upgrade.

subject: Bombchu
text: Collecting 40 Skulltulas gives 10 Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
40 Skulltulas: Gives you 10 Bombchus, and you probably have them already,
 leaving this prize to be almost useless.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Collecting 50 Skulltulas gives a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: 50 Skulltulas: Gives you a Piece of Heart, and is a very good prize.

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Collecting all 100 Gold Skulltulas cures the final member of the family and gives a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
There are 100 Gold 
Skulltulas in the game, and getting them all cures the final member of the 
family and gives you a special prize....100 Skulltulas: Gives you a Huge Rupee, which is worth 200 Rupees.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Compass Room of the Second Floor in Great Deku Tree, a Gold Skulltula is in the left alcove after raising the platforms.

evidence.quote:
In the Compass Room of the Second Floor, head into the left
 alcove after raising the platforms.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Master Quest Great Deku Tree, break open the large crate right beside the treasure chest that contained the Dungeon Map by rolling into it to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Right beside the treasure chest that contained the Dungeon Map is a
 large crate. Break it open by rolling into it to reveal this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the first basement watery room of Great Deku Tree, a Gold Skulltula is on the vines leading back up to the First Floor.

evidence.quote:
There's a Gold Skulltula on the vines leading back up to the
 First Floor in the first basement's watery room. Kill it with the Fairy
 Slingshot then climb up to get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Master Quest Great Deku Tree Compass room, throw a bomb or set a Bombchu to blow up the rocks atop the climbable vines to reach a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the Compass room (formerly known as the Slingshot room in OoT),
 there's some vines to climb that lead to rocks. Throw a bomb up there as it's
 ready to explode/set a Bombchu to blow them up, then climb up and retrieve the
 Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Great Deku Tree, another Gold Skulltula is on the eastern grate in the watery basement room.

evidence.quote:
There's another Gold Skulltula on the eastern grate in the
 same room. Kill it from a distance then jump over to the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Master Quest Great Deku Tree gravestone room, step on the blue switch to light torches, burn the northwest webbing with a Deku Stick, and enter the door to Boomerang the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the room with four torches and a bunch of gravestones, kill the
 Keese there so they won't give you trouble, and step on the blue switch to
 light the torches as long as the switch is pressed. Light a Deku Stick and
 take it to the northwest webbing to burn it. Enter the door, kill the enemies,
 and Boomerang the Skulltula and its token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Kokiri Forest at night, a Gold Skulltula is behind the Know-it-all Brothers house, the westernmost hut in the village.

evidence.quote:
Once back at the village at night, at night, you'll find this Gold
 Skulltula behind the Know-it-all Brothers house, the westernmost hut in the
 village.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the Hyrule Market guard house, roll into the crate next to the guard to break it and release a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter the walls of town, head into the guard's
 house. Roll into the crate next to the guard here to break it and release this
 Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On Hyrule Castle grounds, rolling into the lone tree where the owl sat knocks down a Gold Skulltula from its branches.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you reach the castle grounds, there's a lone tree in
 plain sight. (The one the owl was on.) Roll into the tree to knock down a Gold
 Skulltula from its branches.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Beside Talon's house at Lon Lon Ranch, rolling into the lone tree knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Beside Talon's house, there's a lone tree with a few crates. Roll
 into the tree to knock down this Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At Lon Lon Ranch, a Gold Skulltula lies behind the horse corral.

evidence.quote: Behind the horse corral the Gold Skulltula lies.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping a bottle of bugs onto the plot of dirt beside the Kokiri Shop causes a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
Head to the the plot of dirt beside the Kokiri Shop and drop the
 bottle of bugs onto the dirt plot. As long as one bug burrows straight into 
 the hole, a Gold Skulltula will pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: After entering Lost Woods, head left twice to find a plot of dirt and drop bugs on it to pop out a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Once you enter the Lost Woods, head left twice to find a plot of
 dirt. Drop the bugs on it, and another Gold Skulltula will pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Lost Woods, go right, left, right, then left twice to reach a grassy area and drop bugs on the dirt plot behind a Deku Scrub to make a Gold Skulltula pop out.

evidence.quote:
Once you enter Lost Woods, head right, left, right, then left twice
 to reach a grassy area. There's a plot of dirt behind a Deku Scrub. Drop bugs
 on the plot of dirt to make this Gold Skulltula pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Kakariko Village, rolling into the lone tree near the entrance knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The lone tree near the entrance hides this Gold Skulltula. Roll
 into the tree to knock it down.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In Kakariko Village, a Gold Skulltula sits near the window on the south side of the Skulltula House.

evidence.quote:
On the south side of the Skulltula House, a Gold Skulltula sits
 near the window.
